title: Vercel mark
description: A small solid brand mark in ink (an icon you pass in, about 22px), optionally followed by the name as a tight medium-weight wordmark. Links home.
notes: pass any lucide icon (filled) or your own svg as the mark; the name is read to screen readers when hidden
name: vercel-mark

props.name: brand
props.description: the company name: shown next to the mark when showName is set, read to screen readers otherwise

props.name: mark
props.description: the mark itself (an svg or lucide icon); sized by the size prop

props.name: showName
props.description: show the name as a wordmark after the mark
